description: Reset all Chamber session state and release effects when the artifact, iframe source, inline source, or sandbox changes.
Resolve root-relative catalog iframe URLs relative to the packaged document for Electron file URLs.
Report absent simulation sources before creating an empty iframe.
Reject unsupported, malformed, or credential-bearing iframe URLs before loading them.
Turn indefinitely stalled iframe loads into a retryable error after 30 seconds.
Cancel pending load deadlines on completion, failure, retry, and unmount.
Detach injected click handlers when iframe documents are removed, and clear retained document references.
Read the current clock when the initialization timer fires without restarting the timer on clock changes.
Send same-origin iframe image clicks directly through the safe receiver instead of posting from the wrong window.
Preview the selected responsive image currentSrc rather than the fallback src.
Insert the inline iframe image bridge before closing body tags regardless of case or trailing whitespace.
Address inline image messages to the actual parent origin, using wildcard only for opaque file origins.
Accept verified messages from the configured external iframe origin.
Require own payload fields and reject array-shaped image messages.
Validate payload data descriptors without invoking untrusted getters.
Reject image URLs with leading or trailing whitespace or embedded control characters.
Reject empty raster data and non-base64 characters or misplaced padding in image data URLs.
Recognize safe data image schemes and media types case-insensitively.
Support safe HTTP image previews on IPv6 loopback for local development.
Allow packaged image files only below the application directory and reject encoded path traversal.
Keep the current asset viewer stable and suppress duplicate logs during repeated or replacement image messages.
Make content behind the asset dialog inert and hide it from the accessibility tree.
Capture the modal opener before applying inert content, restore connected targets without scrolling, and avoid refocus on image updates.
Prevent extracted image requests from disclosing the parent URL as a referrer.
Show an accessible failure message when an extracted image cannot load.
Announce iframe loading progress as a live status.
Expose iframe loading with aria-busy and defer keyboard focus until loading completes.

description: Format midnight as 00:00:00 with an explicit h23 hour cycle.
Make frozen clock replay independent of the machine timezone by defaulting to UTC.
Allow callers to select an explicit timezone for frozen clock displays.
Reject invalid frozen clock seeds with a useful RangeError.
Freeze live and fake clock providers to prevent accidental mutation of their methods.
Treat nonfinite field coordinates as an empty field instead of propagating NaN.
Support missing or non-array source collections as empty fields.
Skip malformed source entries and negative or nonfinite strengths and radii.
Use hypot for potential distances so squared coordinates cannot overflow prematurely.
Divide potential source terms before multiplication to avoid overflowing mass products.
Compute gradients with normalized directions and saturate extreme components without making perpendicular zero components NaN.
Set the gradient to zero inside the constant-potential softened core.
Clamp singular and out-of-domain potential values in curvature and Shapiro delay calculations.
Reject nonfinite ray velocity and gradient inputs before calculating curvature.
Scale curvature determinants to preserve cancellation and signed symmetry for extreme inputs.

description: Convert fractional word frequencies into complete prior occurrence counts.
Fall back to default repetition parameters when multipliers or escalation are negative or nonfinite.
Saturate per-word and total entropy costs at safe integers to prevent overflow.
Treat invalid text or words as empty input without throwing.
Use a null-prototype, lazily populated repetition map so constructor-like tokens count correctly and large dictionaries are not copied for every keystroke.
